prompt:
Research the official free-tier limits of the GitHub Actions service for public and private repositories (minutes, storage, concurrency). Cite the GitHub documentation page you used.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the search results from GitHub's official documentation, here are the free-tier limits for GitHub Actions:

**For Public Repositories:**
- Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free and unlimited for public repositories
- Usage includes free minutes, artifact storage, and cache storage without quotas
- Larger runners are always charged, even for public repositories

**For Private Repositories:**
Free usage depends on your GitHub plan and includes monthly quotas that reset at the start of each billing cycle. Here are the key limits:

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "The following amounts of time for standard runners, artifact storage, and cache storage are included in your GitHub plan." | CLAIM: GitHub provides free tier limits for private repositories based on account plan

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-github-actions/about-billing-for-github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Free: 500 MB artifact storage, 2,000 minutes per month, 10 GB cache storage" | CLAIM: Free plan includes limited monthly minutes and storage

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Pro: 1 GB artifact storage, 3,000 minutes per month, 10 GB cache storage" | CLAIM: Pro plan includes higher free tier limits than Free plan

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-github-actions/about-billing-for-github-actions | QUOTE: "The artifact storage amounts shown are shared with GitHub Packages." | CLAIM: Storage allowance is shared between Actions artifacts and GitHub Packages

**Concurrency Limits:**

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Free | 20 concurrent jobs" | CLAIM: Free accounts have a concurrency limit of 20 jobs

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "Free plan: Maximum concurrent macOS jobs: 5" | CLAIM: Free accounts have a limit of 5 concurrent macOS jobs

**Additional Notes:**
- Self-hosted runners are always free for both public and private repositories
- Cache storage is separate from artifact storage (10 GB per repository for all plans)
- Larger runners are always paid, even for public repositories
- Free minutes reset to the full amount at the start of each billing cycle

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Specific concurrency limits for public repositories (searches only showed limits for private repositories based on plans)
